tweets.text:
Another day where the fomo port has essentially been flat.

Sharing this because I believe it’s important for a lot of you to understand that winning takes patience.

Don’t overtrade the positions you believe in.

If your initial thesis is still valid - stack them instead.

e.g. I believe this bull market is still incredibly early and so is growth in the Robinhood Chain ecosystem.

We’re still in a stage of the market where the lore and narrative for this next bull run is being established.

HMM has been the dominate figure on PONS for an extended period of time, which is the dominant launchpad on the chain.

And I do believe cats are the dogs of this cycle.

It’s natural for people to rotate and take profit on early runners to try and fomo into whatever the trendy coin of the day is.

But in a bull market - early winners that have solid memes and solid communities find ways to keep winning.

HMM hasn’t been at the top of PONS every single day - it wasn’t early on. But it found its way up there.

Same story applies to today.

Plenty of growth is happening on the platform and chain which is bullish.

Eventually - this will run hard back to the top again.

If Solana had multiple dogs but $5B last bull market, I see no reason why Robinhood Chain can’t have multiple cats hit much higher.

I believe it’s a matter of when, not if.

So I’m fine not winning every day as long as I remain confident I’ll win in the long run.

Just stack and chill, and let the rest take care of itself.

Be more bullish 🤔🐈
